speech_verification.heard: Staff measured a growing bend, two days later the Quebec Bridge fell. On August 27, steel member 9L bent farther. Some called it critical, the superintendent saw no danger. On August 29, the unfinished bridge collapsed. The commission found the lower members were defectively designed. It did not believe the fall preventable after August 27. Yet it said better judgment might have prevented the loss of life, the bend had been measured.

notes.hook: Establishing a fatal flaw followed by a quick disaster effectively holds attention.
notes.clarity: The timeline and the specific technical failure are easy to understand.
notes.payoff: The tragic conclusion regarding avoidable loss of life provides a poignant ending.
notes.visuals: Archive photos and diagrams are relevant and support the technical narrative well.
notes.loop: The repetition of the measurement concept creates a very smooth transition.

rounds.better_than_last: This short utilizes technical diagrams to explain the disaster more clearly than the rescue-focused ep054.
